params.areas_readme: First matching doc glob wins. area is a list of git pathspecs, and {dir} is the doc's own folder; the doc itself is always excluded. An empty area means the doc is a record that covers nothing in this repo (a log, an off-site record or external research): it has no lag and no dated claim to judge, and the paths and npm scripts it names are history, so docs.dead_paths and docs.dead_scripts skip it. The default says each doc covers the folder it sits in.
params.overlays_readme: A folder an export places elsewhere, as { dir, onto, why }: a public folder whose files land at another repo's root has onto "". A doc under dir resolves each link and named path as if it sat at onto plus its path inside dir, in dir first, then in the repository; a link starting with / starts at onto, and one that climbs out of onto is broken. A malformed entry makes docs.broken_links and docs.dead_paths could not check.
params.community_files_readme: GitHub's community health files, as { name, globs }: a file at any glob counts as present. GitHub reads each from the repo root, docs/ or .github/.
